description: Christchurch Post-Earthquake 0.1m Urban Aerial Photos Index Tiles (24 February 2011) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Imagery. Index Tiles ONLY, for actual orthophotos see layer Christchurch Post-Earthquake 0. 1m Urban Aerial Photos (24 February 2011) Orthophotography of the area affected by the Christchurch Earthquake, 22 February 2011 for the Christchurch Response Centre (CRC). Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Imagery. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2022-06-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
